key_path: Sign up at console.mistral.ai (email or SSO providers)
Phone verification by SMS for Free mode (one number per free plan, per help center; the docs quickstart doesn't mention it)
Free mode is on by default with no card
Studio > API Keys > Create new key (name, expiration, connector scope)

agent_native_auth.cli_login_browser_or_device: yes for Vibe. The Vibe CLI setup wizard opens a browser to sign in and stores credentials; a pasted API key is the alternative
agent_native_auth.oauth_dynamic_client_registration: no. The remote MCP uses a static Bearer API key
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: partial. The Admin API (Admin API key) manages users, workspaces, API keys, limits and audit logs. Service accounts plus workload identity federation give short-lived tokens without stored secrets
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: yes. Workspace-scoped keys, connector access scope, expiration policies
agent_native_auth.free_credits_or_tier: yes. Free mode, no card, rate-limited (opt-in to data training on the free plan, per help center)

product_mcp.scope: Studio workspace as tools, including WRITE tools: Skills, workflows/executions, schedules, evaluations, app deploy/rollback/publish

mcp.one_click_install: copy-paste commands for Vibe (`vibe mcp add`), Claude Code (`claude mcp add --transport http ...`) and Codex. No deeplinks

score_justification: Free tier with no card, a remote product MCP with write tools on the main API host, an Admin API, WIF and full markdown/OpenAPI docs. Only the phone OTP and the lack of OAuth hold it back.
best_practice: The product MCP sits at api.mistral.ai/mcp and uses the same API key, so once you have a key it is one command to connect.
biggest_gap: The MCP has no OAuth, so an agent still has to get a key a human copied out of the dashboard. The phone OTP gates the free tier.
notes_out_of_date: Help-center articles still say 'Experiment plan'; current docs call it 'Free mode'.
